question: In which year was Asha Bhosle's name entered into the Guinness Book of World Records for most studio recordings?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 4**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Asha Bhosle's** name was entered into the Guinness Book of **World Records for the most studio recordings in 2011.**
 
• She had recorded up to** 11,000 solo, duet and chorus-backed songs in over 20 Indian languages** during her career as a playback singer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Asha Bhosle is a legendary Indian playback singer who has recorded over **12,000 songs** in various languages including** Hindi, Bengali, Marathi, Telugu, Tamil, and Gujarati.**
 
• She was born on **September 8, 1933, in Sangli, Maharashtra, India.**
 
• Bhosle began her career as a playback singer in **1943** and has since become one of the most prominent and versatile singers in Indian cinema.
 
• She has won numerous awards for her singing, including the **National Film Award for Best Female Playback Singer and the Filmfare Lifetime Achievement Award.**
 
• **Bhosle** is known for her distinctive voice and ability to sing a wide range of genres, from classical Indian music to **pop and jazz.**
 
• She has collaborated with many legendary composers and singers in the **Indian music industry and has also sung for international films.**
